description: Fix calculator logic in miuhc.html to be completely error-free per the user's blueprint: proper boundary checks, correct Smart plan restrictions based on actual data availability, fallback values, and correct lookup algorithm.
steps: 1. In public/pages/miuhc.html, update the Smart plan availability logic (updateSmartAvailability function) to disable Smart plan toggle for ALL plans that don't have a Smart variant in Syariah mode. Based on the actual sya_inap data: only Diamond Smart, Ruby Smart, Emerald Smart, Topaz Smart, and Topaz ID Smart exist. Plans without Smart variant in Syariah: Jade, Jade ID, AND Sapphire. In Konvensional mode, all plans have Smart variants including Topaz ID Smart, Jade ID Smart, etc.

2. Update the plan grid (buildPlanGrid function) to visually mark/disable plans that have no Smart variant when Smart mode is active. If Smart is already toggled ON and user switches to Syariah with an incompatible plan (Jade/Jade ID/Sapphire), auto-select a compatible plan or auto-disable Smart.

3. Add robust error handling in the recalc() function: if DATA lookup returns undefined/null/NaN for any combination, show a user-friendly message 'Plan tidak tersedia untuk profil ini' instead of displaying 0 or broken output. Never display NaN, undefined, or negative numbers.
4. Validate age input in setUsia(): ensure it's always an integer between 0-85. Handle edge cases like empty string, decimal input, negative numbers, or values over 85.

5. Ensure the Rawat Jalan rider correctly uses sya_jalan for Syariah (which only has plans up to Topaz ID Smart - no Jade Smart, Jade ID Smart, Sapphire Smart, Sapphire) and konv_jalan for Konvensional. If rider premi lookup fails, show rider as unavailable for that plan/age combo rather than adding 0.
6. Ensure the Rawat Gigi rider correctly uses sya_gigi data (also only up to Topaz ID Smart). Same fallback logic as step 5.

7. When user toggles between Konvensional and Syariah, reset any incompatible state: if on Syariah with Smart enabled and plan is Sapphire, either disable Smart or switch plan. If Gigi rider was checked and user switches to Konvensional, uncheck and disable it properly.
8. Add a check: if inapPremi is 0 but the plan should have data (i.e., the lookup path exists but value is 0 or missing), show 'Data premi tidak ditemukan' rather than an empty state.

9. Verify the user's sample calculation works correctly: Syariah, PRIA, 0 tahun, Diamond (non-Smart), should show Rp42.551.900 for Rawat Inap. With Rawat Jalan added: +Rp12.026.200. With Rawat Gigi added: +Rp2.872.300. Total: Rp57.450.400.
acceptance_criteria: Syariah PRIA age 0 Diamond Rawat Inap displays exactly Rp 42.551.900
Smart plan toggle is disabled and unchecked when Sapphire, Jade, or Jade ID is selected in Syariah mode
No NaN, undefined, or empty values appear for any valid combination of inputs (age 0-85, all plans, both genders, both products)
When an unavailable plan/smart combo is selected, a clear message 'Plan tidak tersedia untuk profil ini' is shown
Rider premi preview shows dash when rider data is unavailable for current selection rather than +Rp 0
Total calculation is always the sum of inap + jalan (if checked and available) + gigi (if checked, Syariah, and available)
Age input is clamped to 0-85 integer, non-numeric input doesn't crash the calculator
verification: Open the HTML file and manually verify the sample calculation matches: Syariah, PRIA, 0 tahun, Diamond = Rp42.551.900
Verify no JavaScript errors in the calculator by checking the inline script logic handles all edge cases
